title: cargo-allow policy revision record v1
description: Append-only record under .allow/revisions/ documenting why a governed exception or policy entry changed posture. Contract: CARGO-ALLOW-ADR-0002.

id.description: Stable record id; append-only, never reused.

created.description: ISO date the record was written.

owner.description: Accountable owner for the recorded change.

reason.description: Why the posture change is justified.

allow_ids.description: Stable allow ids this record covers. One record may cover multiple entries.

change_kinds.description: Canonical PolicyChangeKind tokens this record authorizes. Empty lists (blanket waivers) are rejected.

before_fingerprint.description: Optional fingerprint of the pre-edit state for a repeatable weakening transition.

after_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the head entry's post-edit state; required to cover a repeatable weakening kind (occurrence_limit_loosened, expiry_extended, review_after_extended, scope_broadened, selector_precision_decreased).

links.description: Provenance links: issue:, pr:, doc:, commit:, or url: prefixed.

expires.description: Optional advisory freshness bound; an ISO date or "never". Records do not auto-expire on merge.

supersedes.description: Id of a prior record this one replaces (append-only correction chain).

superseded_by.description: Id of a later record that replaces this one.
